research_receipts.claim: An aware clock anchor carries enough timezone offset information for time comparison.
research_receipts.limitations: A library contract does not prove that acquisition happened after the direct turn.

research_receipts.claim: A constrained date profile reduces ambiguous relative date output.
research_receipts.limitations: This date profile does not own current civil time or user intent.
